summary: A playful, emotional webpage asking a girl named Saachi to come back after she left after the first date saying 'this isn't working out'. Harry Potter themed with Slytherin house aesthetic. Features a heartfelt message with 🥺 emoji including the line 'you are my patronus Saachi', a 'Yes' button and a 'No' button that runs away when hovered/clicked and displays random witty quips. Saachi has a nickname 'Windshields' (due to her glasses) which is integrated. The core message is simply asking her to please come back, keeping tone hopeful and sweet without over-explaining.
architectural_notes: Core message focus: simply asking Saachi to please come back with 🥺 emoji — she left after the first date saying 'this isn't working out'. Keep messaging simple and heartfelt, not over-explained.

existing_features.title: Create a main page with a heartfelt, centered message addressed to 'Saachi', asking her to please come back and give a second chance to make things right. The message must prominently feature the 🥺 emoji and be written in a sweet, sincere tone.

Add a 'Yes 🥺' button and a 'No' button below the message. When 'Yes' is clicked, display a joyful celebratory response screen with confetti animation, hearts, and a happy message like 'Yay! I promise to make it right!'. The Yes button should be large, visually prominent, and inviting.

Make the 'No' button run away whenever the user tries to hover over it or click it: the button must animate and teleport to a random position on screen within viewport bounds each time the cursor approaches or clicks it. Each time it runs away, it must also display a random witty playful quip near the button. The quips should cycle through a predefined list of at least 10 varied quips such as: 'Nope!', 'You sure about that?', 'Try again!', 'Nice try!', 'I am faster than you!', 'That is not an option!', 'You cannot click me!', 'Almost!', 'Not today!', 'Keep dreaming!'.

Apply a romantic, soft, and whimsical visual theme: use warm rose and pink and cream tones, elegant flowing typography for the main message, floating heart or petal animations in the background, and a layout that feels emotionally inviting. Ensure the design is consistent across all states including initial, yes response, and no-button-running states.
Render the generated romantic background image as a static asset from frontend/public/assets/generated and apply it as the full-page background.

Redesign the full visual theme of the app to be Harry Potter themed with a Slytherin house aesthetic. Replace the current romantic rose/pink/cream palette with Slytherin colors: deep emerald green, silver, and dark charcoal/near-black. Update typography to feel magical and wizarding (use a serif or gothic-style font for headings where possible). Replace floating hearts/petals background animations with magical elements such as floating golden sparks, stars, or magical particles. Update all UI components (MainCard, CelebrationScreen, RunawayButton, FloatingHearts) to reflect the Slytherin/Harry Potter theme consistently across all states (initial, yes-celebration, and no-button-running).

Add the line 'You are my Patronus, Saachi 🥺' somewhere prominently on the main page, integrated naturally into or below the existing heartfelt message. Style it to feel magical and emotionally resonant, consistent with the Slytherin/Harry Potter theme.

Generate a new full-page background image with a Harry Potter / Slytherin aesthetic: a dark, magical scene featuring deep emerald greens, silver accents, soft magical glowing effects (like floating lights or spell sparks), and a moody enchanted atmosphere evoking the Slytherin common room or a magical castle dungeon. Replace the existing romantic background image with this new one, applying it as the full-page background in App.tsx.

Integrate Saachi's nickname 'Windshields' (earned from her glasses) naturally into the main page message. This could appear as a playful, affectionate aside or secondary line alongside or below the primary message addressing 'Saachi', e.g. 'my Windshields' or 'Saachi (aka Windshields)'. It should feel warm and personal, consistent with the Slytherin/Harry Potter theme.

Update all messaging across the app (MainCard, CelebrationScreen, and any quips in RunawayButton) to reflect that they only went on one date — not a relationship. Remove any phrasing that implies the user 'messed up', 'made a mistake', or 'ruined something'. Reframe the tone as: 'we had one magical date and I'd love another chance to see where this goes', hopeful and light rather than apologetic or remorseful.

Update the main page message in MainCard to clearly reflect the context: she left after the first date saying 'this isn't working out', and the message is simply asking her to please come back and give it another chance. The tone must be sweet, hopeful, and sincere — centered on 'please come back 🥺' — without any framing of messing up, mistakes, or apologies. Remove any language that implies a longer relationship or wrongdoing.

Update the CelebrationScreen (shown after 'Yes' is clicked) so its messaging aligns with the one-date context — celebrating the prospect of a second date, not 'making things right' or fixing anything. It should feel joyful and forward-looking, e.g. 'Yay! Can't wait for our next date! 🥺'.
Audit and update all quips in RunawayButton to ensure none imply a relationship, wrongdoing, or apology context. All quips should remain playful and witty, consistent with the one-date scenario.

Yes and No buttons; No button runs away (moves randomly) when hovered/clicked and shows random quips
Harry Potter theme with Slytherin house aesthetic (green/silver colors, HP typography, magical elements)
Add the line 'you are my patronus Saachi' somewhere in the page
Integrate Saachi's nickname 'Windshields' (from her glasses) somewhere in the page
Update messaging to reflect they only went on one date (not a relationship), remove any 'I messed up' or 'made a mistake' framing
